4365.title: Pending turn survives start watchdog
4365.rootCauseOneLine: The start watchdog warns without clearing or settling a pending turn, so later runtime turn requests remain blocked.
4365.proposedFix: Define safe cancellation or fencing before retry, then reconcile server state and queued input.
4365.caveats: High confidence applies to the runtime stall; reconnect, persisted queue and UI were not reproduced end to end. No simple fix without a recovery policy across subsystems.
